{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Columbia Gulf Transmission Pipeline''' is a natural gas pipeline in the United States, with 3 segments tracked by Global Energy Monitor.

==Location==
Maysville Project: The pipeline runs from Columbia Gulf mainline tie-in, Rowan County, Kentucky to North Maysville delivery meter station, Hugh L. Spurlock Power Station, Mason County, Kentucky.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-01-20/pdf/2026-00985.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
Pulaski Project: The pipeline runs from Columbia Gulf mainline, Lincoln County, Kentucky to South Somerset Delivery Meter Station, Pulaski County, Kentucky.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://public-inspection.federalregister.gov/2025-23711.pdf|title=public-inspection.federalregister.gov|website=public-inspection.federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/news-events/events/scoping-meeting-pulaski-project-cp26-11-000-somerset-ky-11242025|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
Vicksburg Lateral: The pipeline runs from Columbia Gulf mainline, Richland Parish, Louisiana to Baxter Wilson Plant and Warren Power Plant interconnections, Warren County, Mississippi.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-11-16/pdf/00-29347.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
